title: The Road Home
subtitle: One toll, and the road is yours
description: The bell has said its one word and the whole parish heard it,
including the parts of the parish that are currently fish. The road
home is the road out, walked backwards, in air, at the speed of
somebody who has been underwater since breakfast.
Its reward is written inline rather than in a table file: a
`tasked:random` roll carrying its own `entries`, with the usual
weight-zero entry at the top -- the one that always lands, so the
roll promises something even when the fashionable weights miss.
